name: Miracuves Editor Optimizer
author: miracuves

sections.description:
Miracuves Editor Optimizer helps you keep the Elementor backend fast by focusing on what you actually use.

It can scan your content to see which Elementor widgets are really in use, highlight unused widgets, and let you disable them in the editor with safeguards (safe mode, essentials protected). You get usage analytics, addon breakdown, and optional full-site scans so decisions are based on data—not guesswork.

For each editing session you can use Launch Modes: Build Mode loads the full editor (all widgets and plugins) when you are designing; Edit Mode applies lighter session-only options such as Editor Firewall (fewer plugins in that session), snapshot cache (where enabled), and Widget Diet (unregister unused widget types for that session). A small optional mu-plugin powers the firewall so only the editor session is affected.

Core design: optimizations target the Elementor editor and related admin flows so your public frontend stays unchanged unless you deliberately enable something broader. Settings include editor memory, asset-related options, and WordPress tweaks where applicable.

Powered by Miracuves Solutions. Product site: wpstack.online.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the miracuves-editor-optimizer folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Ensure Elementor 3.0+ is active.
  4. Go to Settings → Miracuves Editor Optimizer and run Scan Widget Usage Now when you want a full picture.

For Editor Firewall, copy meo-firewall.php from the plugin directory to wp-content/mu-plugins/ as documented in the plugin settings.
sections.faq:
Does this change my site’s frontend?

By default, features are aimed at the Elementor editor and related admin. Review each setting before enabling anything that could affect the public site.

Where do I get support?

See wpstack.online and your hosting documentation for PHP/memory limits.
